title: Staff alignment bridge — prep notes & action items (Mar 12)
content:
Purpose: quick, usable notes to take into the 1hr staff bridge tomorrow. Focus is alignment on near-term risk mitigations (SLOs, Dedicated capacity), decision asks, and clear owners for follow-ups.

Top-line ask(s) to land in meeting:
- Approve temporary SLA relaxation plan for model v2 rollout (30d window) so we can finish quantization backlog without risk of immediate rollbacks. Need +1 from CFO on cost runway impact.
- Greenlight a limited Dedicated burst pilot with infra team for top-3 customers to validate autoscale delta. Budget ask: up to $35k for proof-of-concept.

Pre-read snapshots (one-liners I want folks to have in their head):
- SRE: 99.6% api p95 over last 7d, two latency spikes tied to cache eviction on 2/28 and 3/6. Root cause narrowed to KV cache GC across multi-model shards.
- Serving runtime: v2 quantization shows ~18% cost reduction, but 2 regressions on hallucination tests on prompts >1024 tokens.
- Sales/CS: Three named accounts signaled readiness for Dedicated pilot if we can guarantee capacity + runbook.

Agenda (60m) — compact, time-boxed
- 0-5m: Quick context + goals (me)
- 5-20m: SRE ops health + immediate mitigations (Daniel)
  - ask: confirm GC patch ETA and temporary throttle strategy
- 20-35m: Serving/runtime update (Engineering lead)
  - ask: show quantization eval snapshot, list of failing evals, can we temporarily pin older variant for affected customers?
- 35-45m: Dedicated pilot & commercial ask (Leah + Sales)
  - ask: approve $35k budget and pilot SOW outline
- 45-55m: Risk register + compliance check for Private deployment asks (Legal/Security rep)
  - ask: any red flags for on-prem SLO relaxation or short-term exception?
- 55-60m: Decide next steps + owners (me)

Key decisions we need in-meeting
- Approve SLA relaxation window: Yes / No / Modify (owner: CFO)
- Budget for Dedicated pilot: Approve / Scope back (owner: Head of Revenue)
- Rollout gating: must pass hallucination regression suite or allow canary with rollback policy (owner: Eng-ML lead)

Open questions I want to ask the CEO/COO if time permits
- Are we comfortable with a 30d SLA exception vs a staged canary that applies only to non-production customers? (win = less customer-blast radius)
- Do we want to make the Dedicated pilot a paid early-access or free? (revenue implication + signals)

Parking-lot (not for this meeting unless time)
- Deep-dive on prefix cache strategies and eviction thresholds with ML infra (30–45m follow-up)
- Longer-term: unified routing policy for cost-tier mapping across Dedicated/Hosted/Private.

Immediate action items (my scratch action log)
- [ ] Draft short SLA exception memo and send to CFO + legal by EOD today. Owner: Maya. Due: 2026-03-12 17:00. Linked: CONFLUENCE-1234.
- [ ] Get SRE GC patch ETA and write short rollback plan (Daniel). Due: 2026-03-12 12:00.
- [ ] Engineering to produce a 1-slide quantization safety summary (failing prompts + mitigation) (Eng-ML). Due: 2026-03-12 15:00.
- [ ] Leah to confirm pilot SOW (names of pilot customers, expected throughput, contact points). Due: 2026-03-13.
- [ ] Security to validate on-prem exception checklist; flag any audit needs (Security). Due: 2026-03-13.

Notes-to-self / phrasing to use in meeting
- "This is about buying time to finish the quantization/quality backlog while we avoid a capacity-driven incident."
- "Proposal is narrowly scoped: 30d, limited customers, explicit rollback triggers."
- Bring cost delta as clear numbers (per-1M-token cost difference).

Quick metric snippets to have ready (talking points, not slides)
- API p95 last 7d: 420ms (baseline target: 350ms)
- Total tokens/day: ~1.8B (hosted + dedicated subset)
- Quantization avg cost reduction: 18% -> approx $0.14/1k tokens saved

Follow-up cadence after meeting (recommended)
- 48h: confirm decisions + publish one-pager to exec thread (owner: Maya)
- 7d: status check on pilot onboarding and SRE patch (owner: Leah + Daniel)
- 30d: wrap-up report on SLA exception outcomes and whether rollback was required (owner: Eng-ML)

Quick scratch links (copy into message if asked)
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-1234 (SLA exception proposal)
- Jira: JIRA-OPS-987 (GC patch)
- Slack channel: #exec-ops-bridge

Loose brainstorming (things I might say off-script)
- If CFO pushes back on $35k: offer phased pilot — start with 1-2 accounts for $10k, expand after telemetry looks good.
- If Security pushes back on on-prem exception: propose extra logging + weekly attestation from customer as a compromise.

End-of-doc quick checklist before joining
- [ ] Email pre-read to exec inbox (attach 1-pager + 1-slide quantization summary)
- [ ] DM Daniel to confirm he's ready to speak to GC patch
- [ ] Load quick metric dashboard and pin p95 + token volume

Random notes (scratch)
- Remember to call out that Dedicated pilot is both a product and ops ask — need commit from Sales and SRE to support handoffs.
- Keep phrasing crisp: "approve pilot" vs "approve budget" — make the exact decision we need obvious.
